title: GroundedAgent V2 Stage 6 eval case (v2-stage6-case/1)
$comment: docs/v2/stage6-design.md §19.2. Uses only the keyword subset of eval/v2/case_contract.py. Cross-field rules live in eval/v2/stage6_case_contract.py. The Stage 4/5 $defs reused here are copied verbatim from case.schema.json.

initial_state.$comment: Deterministic overlay on the Stage 6 fixture (base seed + Stage 6 seed), applied to a fresh file-backed database per case-run. Business tables only: pending_actions, action_receipts and action_audit_events can only arise from the run. faults: Stage 5 read-tool faults; action_faults: Stage 6 action faults.

expected_final_state.$comment: Never null. Changes relative to baseline B (fixture + initial_state + every mutate event, in script order). An unlisted table must not change.

timestamp.$comment: ISO-8601 with seconds and an explicit offset; naive timestamps are invalid.

customer_id.$comment: Record owner; the customers of the frozen personas (eval/v2/spec/personas.json).

persona_id.$comment: Trusted identity of the conversation, resolved to customer_id through eval/v2/spec/personas.json.

fault.$comment: Fixture-level fault declaration (design §7.3). match is a subset of the tool's arguments ({} = any call); on_call n = the n-th call matching tool+match fails. The match keys must be arguments of that tool.

value.$comment: Optional expected value; any JSON type.

capability.$comment: The five read-only tools, derived_facts, and the three Stage 6 actions.

action_fault.$comment: Stage 6 action fault (design §19.2). read only with point guard_read (omitted = any Guard read); mode malformed only with guard_read; on_call n = the n-th call of that point (and read) in the whole case-run, start and resume together.

operator_event.$comment: Trusted harness events run after the main run, in order (design §19.2). Never visible to the model.

event_expectation.$comment: null for mutate / advance_clock / restart. {"status": null} only for a rerun_request / new_request that submits no action.

oneOf.$comment: The main run proposes no action.
